children: shares traded ~1.23% lower at ~94.19 on Tuesday while the company unveiled an AI-powered revenue OS platform designed to help businesses manage sales, customer interactions, and forecasting in one system.
, the company introduced new Zoom Revenue Accelerator tools, including Engage for managing sales outreach and Forecast for tracking deals and expected revenue.
It also made Common Room by Zoom available, helping businesses use customer activity and engagement data to identify sales and expansion opportunities.
Moreover, it launched ZRA Elite, which combines its existing revenue tools with Engage and Forecast.
Barracuda Networks saw a 15% increase in deals closed and 5% faster deal velocity while using Zoom Revenue Accelerator, said the company.

title: Zoom rolls out AI-powered revenue platform with new sales tools
